items.html: Now, among the GAR themselves too there is a difference between one and another. And it is that from the Keter not even the posterior descended, (30) but only the posterior of NHY. But in AVI of the Nekudim, their posterior alone descended, and the anterior remained in their place. And the reason for the matter is that these lights, which are extended down to the Shibolet of the beard, were divided into three. For the Keter took from the discernment of the Ozen itself, from what the sight draws in looking at the light of the Ozen, and all the more so are the two other lights included in it; and from this a vessel was made for Keter of the Nekudim. And Aba took from what the sight draws from the lights of the Hotem, and the light of the Peh is included in it as well.
